answer: UA and UAA are the same company (Class C and Class A shares); Under Armour Q1 FY2027 (ended June 30, 2026; reported Aug 7, 2026) revenue about $1.1B (-3%).

output.answer:
**UA and UAA are both Under Armour** — just different share classes of the same company. Therefore, they report the **exact same revenue**.

- **UAA** = Class A shares (has voting rights)
- **UA** = Class C shares (no voting rights)

For the most recent quarter (Q3 fiscal 2025, ended Dec. 31, 2024), Under Armour reported revenue of **~$1.4 billion** (or ~$1.33 billion depending on currency adjustments) — and this figure applies to both tickers.

The financials are identical; the only difference is typically share price (UAA usually trades at a slight premium due to voting rights). 

Sources:
- [KULT Recruit - Under Armour Q3 Results](https://blog.kultrecruit.com/under-armour-raises-profit-forecast-for-fiscal-2025-after-stronger-q3-results)
- [FashionUnited - Under Armour Q3 Results](https://fashionunited.com/news/business/under-armour-q3-exceeds-expectations-despite-revenue-decline/2026020670467)
